title: A core on a no-charge line charges nobody and stays at $0.00
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status In Progress, billable, whose line 2 is No Charge under Warranty with Not in ShopView as its original and holds a part with a core, all lines done.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Create invoice.
  3. Answer the core "Not OK".
  4. Finish the completion steps.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The core row on line 2 shows $0.00.

Step 2:

  • The completion steps ask OK or NOT OK for line 2's core.

Step 3:

  • No charge is added for the core.

Step 4:

  • The invoice is created with line 2 and its core at $0.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-E3: “If a part on a no-charge line is a core: the core part carries no sell price ($0.00 on the work order, estimate, portal and invoice; the vendor core charge is never written as its price, S2-R19); the completion wizard still asks OK or NOT OK for the line; OK creates the vendor return and credit at cost as today, with nothing to remove from the customer; NOT OK charges the customer nothing and the core cost stays on the line and posts to the category account with the part; Mark as Billable afterwards prices the core like the part. Same as S2-E7 for a whole work order.”
